b: 2027 Grammy Awards: The complete list of nominations The nominations for the 69th annual Grammy Awards were announced on Monday, and women artists across genres rule the major categories.

The British singer-songwriter RAYE, whose hit "Where Is My Husband!" dominated charts and social media feeds over the past year, leads the 2027 Grammy field with 11 nominations.

hide caption
The nominations for the 69th annual Grammy Awards were announced on Monday, and women artists across genres dominate the major categories.

The British singer-songwriter RAYE, whose breakthrough song "Where Is My Husband!" was a hit on the pop charts as well as social media feeds over the past year, leads the field with 11 nominations. That ties a record Beyoncé set in 2025 for the number of nominations earned by a woman artist in a single year. "Husband!" is up for record and song of the year, and RAYE's This Music May Contain Hope. is nominated for album of the year.

The Spanish artist Rosalía, whose classical-influenced album Lux features the artist singing in 14 languages on songs that span a number of genres, comes in second place for most nominations, racking up nine nods. Rosalía, who took home song of the year and album of the year at the Latin Grammys just last week, has only been nominated four times at the Grammys. She has won twice in the Latin rock or alternative album category. This year, her nominations come in album, song and record of the year, plus pop, alternative, Latin and global categories.

Other artists picking up major nominations include the breakout country star and best new artist nominee Ella Langley, whose "Choosin' Texas" recently broke the record as the longest-running No. 1 song in the history of the Billboard pop chart — it has held the top spot for 27 weeks already this year. Langley and veteran country star Miranda Lambert, who co-wrote "Choosin' Texas," both scored seven nominations. Also with seven nominations is a pair of rock-leaning singer-songwriters: Olivia Rodrigo's third album, You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love, is up for album of the year, as is Lost Weekend by Phoebe Bridgers. Bridgers, who earned her first Grammy awards in 2024 for her work in the band boygenius, was nominated as best new artist in 2021. Rodrigo won that award in 2022.

Of the eight artists competing for album of the year, only two of them have ever won in the category: Taylor Swift and Bruno Mars (who is the only male artist up for the award this year). Along with a genre-diverse mix of names up for best new artist — including New York rock darlings Geese, the experimental rock band Angine de Poitrine and alt-pop star Slayyyter — it's an eclectic list of nominations for the Grammys, which are scheduled to be presented in Los Angeles on Sunday, Feb. 7, 2027.
